title.zh: 【Zero 主网与 lzATLAS 将于 11 月 30 日上线】
title.en: 【Zero 主网与 lzATLAS 将于 11 月 30 日上线】

current_state.zh: LayerZero announced that its Zero mainnet and lzATLAS, the network's first application, will go live on November 30, 2026, initially targeting open markets while institutions test the app for US equities and fixed-income use cases and trading venues run integration, execution, settlement, and performance tests in production environments.
current_state.en: LayerZero announced that its Zero mainnet and lzATLAS, the network's first application, will go live on November 30, 2026, initially targeting open markets while institutions test the app for US equities and fixed-income use cases and trading venues run integration, execution, settlement, and performance tests in production environments.
